refresh_tokens_self_select.name: refresh_tokens_self_select
refresh_tokens_self_select.using:
EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.id = "refresh_tokens"."session_id"
          AND s.user_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid
      )

users_tenant_member_select.name: users_tenant_member_select
users_tenant_member_select.using:
EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM memberships m
        WHERE m.user_id = "users"."id"
          AND m.tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid
      )
